slack.observed: Pasted SPVERIFY-63927B5B1 into Slack search, verified the full query in the search field, then cleared and dismissed it without sending a message.

full-screen.observed: Entered full-screen TextEdit, opened the picker, pasted the marker, and verified the full text-area value; exited full screen.
full-screen.procedure: Paste into a disposable document in a full-screen target app.

second-display.procedure: Open the picker from a target on a second display; verify placement and paste destination.

another-space.procedure: Open the picker and paste into a target on another macOS Space.

secure-input-copy-only.observed: Enabled Terminal Secure Keyboard Entry and confirmed IsSecureEventInputEnabled() was true. Selecting the snippet copied the marker, left the terminal prompt unchanged, and showed the copy-only HUD. Disabled Secure Keyboard Entry and confirmed false.
secure-input-copy-only.procedure: Enable Secure Input in a disposable test target, use a snippet, and verify clipboard-only output and the HUD.

accessibility-revoked-copy-only-banner.procedure: Revoke only Sloppy Paste Accessibility access, verify copy-only behavior and the picker banner, then restore access.

dvorak.procedure: Select Dvorak, paste into a disposable target, and restore the original input source.

rebuild-reinstall-keeps-accessibility.procedure: Rebuild and reinstall with the same signing identity; verify the app still reports Accessibility granted.

target-stays-frontmost.observed: System Events reported DeviceHub, TextEdit, Safari, VS Code, and Terminal as frontmost while the picker window was open over each target.
target-stays-frontmost.procedure: Verify the target remains the frontmost application while the nonactivating picker is open.

click-outside-hides.observed: Clicked the DeviceHub title bar outside the picker; the picker window count became zero and DeviceHub remained frontmost.
click-outside-hides.procedure: Click outside the picker and verify it closes while the target remains usable.

escape-every-depth.observed: Escape was observed from the root picker and editor, but the full list of depths has not been exercised.
escape-every-depth.procedure: Exercise Escape from search, list, action menu, placeholder form, editor, tag picker, history, and confirmation overlays.

form-menus-stay-open.observed: Opened the placeholder form, clicked the tone dropdown, and observed both dropdown and form remain open; selected Casual and pasted the expected rendered text.
form-menus-stay-open.procedure: Open a placeholder dropdown; verify its menu and parent form stay open until selection or dismissal.

filter-menus-stay-open.observed: Opened the tag filter menu, selected verification, and observed the picker remain open with three matching snippets.
filter-menus-stay-open.procedure: Open tag/sort filter menus; verify the picker stays open through selection.

placeholder-tab-order.observed: Tab moved focus from the required name field to the tone dropdown; the remaining control types have not been exercised.
placeholder-tab-order.procedure: Tab and Shift-Tab through text, choice, custom-value, wrapper and guard controls; verify focus follows visible controls.

display-disconnect-repositions.observed: MacBook Pro reported only its built-in display (NSScreen.screens.count = 1); an external display was unavailable for this check.
display-disconnect-repositions.procedure: Disconnect the display hosting the picker and verify the panel moves onto a remaining display.

import-export-focus-return.procedure: Open and cancel import and export panels from a disposable target; verify focus returns to the target.

zoom-resizes-panel.observed: Measured the picker at 1140x720 points, reduced zoom to 950x600, reset to 760x480, then restored the original 1140x720 size.
zoom-resizes-panel.procedure: Change zoom with Command-plus/minus/zero; compare panel dimensions and restore the original zoom.

zoomed-clicks-hit-controls.observed: The form dropdown and Actions item responded at 150% zoom; all field and control hit targets have not been checked.
zoomed-clicks-hit-controls.procedure: At nondefault zoom, click visible fields, dropdowns and action controls; verify hit targets align.

resume-draft-after-dismissal.observed: Created a disposable draft titled ZZ Live Verify Draft with exact test content, dismissed and reopened the picker, then resumed the draft and confirmed both fields matched.
resume-draft-after-dismissal.procedure: Create a uniquely named disposable draft, dismiss/reopen the picker, resume it and verify exact text recovery.

duplicate-opens-editor.observed: Duplicated ZZ Live Verify Duplicate from Actions; the copy opened in the editor with the expected title and content. Data inspection confirmed the original ID, title, and content were unchanged.
duplicate-opens-editor.procedure: Duplicate a disposable snippet; verify the copy opens for editing without changing the source.

settings-hotkey-recorder.procedure: Record a temporary hotkey, verify it opens the picker, test cancel, then restore the original hotkey.

launch-at-login.procedure: Verify login-item registration from the signed installed bundle; restore the original setting. Actual login launch requires a login cycle.
